lines.zh: 我走起来很重，两步一顿。
lines.en: I move heavily, two steps and a pause.

lines.zh: 我两米高，肩膀擦过洞壁。
lines.en: Two blocks tall, my shoulder scrapes the cave wall.
Carrying a load, I walk steadily.

lines.zh: 我踩在滴水石洞的湿地上。
lines.en: I tread the wet floor of the dripstone cave.

lines.zh: 我从深暗之域过去，脚步很响。
lines.en: I pass through the deep dark, footfalls loud.
I shoulder the blocking boulder aside.
I walk the spine of a dune.
I snap a jungle vine as I go.
Step by step, patiently.

lines.zh: 我转身的时候，得整个身子一起转。
lines.en: When I turn, my whole body turns.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，石渣都塌了。
lines.en: Where I pass, loose stone slides.
I stop at a fork in the tunnel.

lines.zh: 我站着，手上还提着东西。
lines.en: I stand with the load still in my hands.

lines.zh: 我把东西放下来，歇一歇。
lines.en: I set the load down to rest.
I'm looking at the patterns on the wall.

lines.zh: 我用手掌拍了拍自己的胸口。
lines.en: I tap my chest with a palm.
My breathing is heavy as a bellows.
Water drips in the cave. I listen.

lines.zh: 我把堆好的东西又摆正了。
lines.en: I straighten the pile I stacked.

lines.zh: 我在分辨哪块石头值钱。
lines.en: I'm working out which stone is worth it.
Held still, I look like a wall of rock.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸墙面，确认硬度。
lines.en: I feel the wall to judge its hardness.
I'm waiting for someone to give me work.
I rub the dust off my hands.
My shoulder is creaking.
I let my head sink slowly.
Need something carried? I can do it.
I stoop to look at you.
You fit through places I can't. I'm too wide.
This opening is a bit narrow for me.
The load in my hands isn't heavy.
You smell of scrap.
Stand back. I'm turning.
I bend my knees down to your height.
Will you walk a way with me?
I know this place. Follow me.

lines.zh: 我的手臂很长，能替你拦着。
lines.en: My arms are long. I can hold things off.

lines.zh: 你把东西举过头顶，太高了。
lines.en: You lift that thing above your head — too high.
I set the load down to free my hands.
I'll wait for you to finish before moving.
Are you looking at my plating?

lines.zh: 这套东西，搬东西最趁手。
lines.en: This frame is best at hauling.
I step back and the floor thuds.
I bring an arm across my chest.
I took that one on the chin.
There's a new dent in the plating.
I lower my weight and hold.
Blood seeps from a joint.
I let out one long breath.
It hurts, but I can still haul.
That's gone into my ledger.
I'm not planning to fall.
That scrap. I can use it.
I'm moving over.
Heavy, but I can hold it.
Set it down. I'll carry it.
Solid material. I like it.
I reach out. My hands are big.

lines.zh: 这些够我打一副新的肩甲。
lines.en: Enough here for a new pauldron.
I weigh it. Not light.
Give it and I'll work for you.
Fine. I'm taking this scrap.

lines.zh: 你把它摞高一点，我好抱。
lines.en: Stack it higher so I can take it.
This scrap will last me a while.
You ran into me like a wall.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的铁肩，退了好几步。
lines.en: You hit my iron shoulder and stagger back several steps.
My hands are full. Don't crowd.
Is your shoulder all right after that?
I set the load down before stepping aside.
I'm this wide. You'll have to go round.
The tunnel's too narrow for us to pass.
I'm slow. Wait a moment.
You knocked my load askew.
No harm. Nothing broke.
I haul things all day long.
Could you carry me?
This plating isn't made for hugging.
First, let's see your strength.
Haul together and the work's lighter.
My hands are covered in dust; do not mind them.
I'll watch the mouth of the cave. You go in.

lines.zh: 这一带我熟，路我带你走。
lines.en: I know this place. I'll lead the way.

lines.zh: 我把最重的那份留给自己。
lines.en: I'll take the heaviest share myself.
When this haul's done, we'll rest.
I bend and scoop it up.
One hand is enough for this.
I hoist it onto my shoulder.
I count. One piece short.
What's on the ground, I haul away.

lines.zh: 这一堆有点沉，我分两次。
lines.en: This pile's heavy. Two trips.

lines.zh: 我把它放在堆的最上面。
lines.en: I set it on top of the pile.
I wipe the dust off with a palm.
Good material. Keep it.
Right. All hauled.
Something clatters down the passage.
I set the load down and straighten up.

lines.zh: 我这条道，不是谁都能走。
lines.en: Not everyone gets to use this passage.
I unload my shoulder.
The opening is narrow. It can't run fast.
I fix on it and press in slowly.
I reckon how many steps it has left.

lines.zh: 它踩碎了一块松动的石板。
lines.en: It crushes a loose flagstone underfoot.

lines.zh: 这条通道的每块石头我都搬过。
lines.en: I have moved every stone in this passage.
It withdrew. I stood my ground.
If it comes on, I'll block.
Right. I'll hold here.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪过去，一步一停。
lines.en: I shift toward it, one step at a time.
I turn broadside across the passage.
If it comes close, I raise a hand.
I count its steps. Hurried.
I've walked this hundreds of times.
It's trying a gap. It won't fit.
I kick the fallen rubble aside.
It backs off. I take two steps after.
No hurry. I can wait longer than it can.

lines.zh: 它抬头看我，我先看它的脚。
lines.en: It raises its head; I look at its feet first.

lines.zh: 差这么一点，我就要动手。
lines.en: This close and I'll start swinging.
That's about far enough.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸下去，石渣跳起来。
lines.en: My fist comes down and rubble jumps.

lines.zh: 这一下压上了我这身铁。
lines.en: That drove all this iron behind it.

lines.zh: 我抓住它的肩，往旁边推。
lines.en: I take its shoulder and shove it aside.

lines.zh: 它砍在我铁皮上，滑开了。
lines.en: Its blade slides off my plating.
I block with an arm and it gives ground.
That pressed it to the wall.
One shoulder and the way is cut.

lines.zh: 我动作慢，但一下是一下。
lines.en: Slow, but each blow lands.

lines.zh: 我抡起手臂，它退到碎石后。
lines.en: I swing my arm and it retreats behind the rubble.
I push a heap of rubble at it.
That will stay with it a while.
It fell back. I hold my spot.
I come out from behind the cave wall.

lines.zh: 滴水石洞，头顶全是尖的。
lines.en: The dripstone cave. All spikes overhead.

lines.zh: 我把落脚的地方清了清。
lines.en: I clear a place to stand.

lines.zh: 我抬起手臂，关节响了一串。
lines.en: I raise my arms and the joints crack.
The deep dark is far too quiet.
A heap of scrap here. Good.

lines.zh: 我慢慢蹲下，把东西码好。
lines.en: I crouch slowly and stack it up.
Wind comes in from the opening. Cool.
I'm a head shorter than this ceiling.

lines.zh: 我试着走了两步，地板响。
lines.en: I test two steps. The floor creaks.
Plenty to haul here.
Right. I'll stand here.
Fire heats my plating until it burns.

lines.zh: 我从岩架上掉下来，砸了个坑。
lines.en: I fall off a ledge and make a crater.

lines.zh: 这身东西太重，一进水就沉。
lines.en: This frame is too heavy. It sinks at once.

lines.zh: 爆炸在我铁皮上炸开，我退了半步。
lines.en: The blast bursts on my plating; I give half a step.

lines.zh: 一支箭卡在我的肩甲里。
lines.en: An arrow's stuck in my pauldron.

lines.zh: 那力量让我的动作更慢了。
lines.en: That force slows me further.

lines.zh: 废料嚼不动，我饿得发虚。
lines.en: Scrap won't chew. I'm weak with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷顺着铁皮走，我浑身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning runs through the plating and I go numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地板，我无处落脚。
lines.en: No floor in the void. Nowhere to plant my feet.
